description: Resume one of your personal access tokens that suspended itself (daily bucket spent, or the tripwire): it authenticates again; today's spend still counts against its bucket, so raise the bucket first with merjax_set_token_bucket if it is spent. A suspended token cannot make this call itself: use another credential. A token that is not suspended is `unchanged`; another person's token is not found. Needs `user` scope. Audit-logged. Returns {tokenId, name, resumed, effect}.

token_id.description: The personal access token's id (merjax_list_tokens, GET /api/v2/user/tokens)

name: merjax_resume_token
